    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

    fits = remaining >= 0
    # Compute utilization before and after
    current_utilization = bins / (bins + 1e-8)  # Avoid division by zero

    # Normalize improvement, penalize overflow with very low score
    priority_scores = np.where(fits, utilization_improvement, -np.inf)
    return priority_scores
